Runs in batch: 8 (r01–r08). Accepted: 8. Flagged: 0. Cleared: 8 (r01, r02, r03, r04, r05, r06, r07, r08).
Checks: rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections all pass on every run. No remedies were kept, there were no roll-backs and no run used the width-free ratio.
Outliers: the batch MAD is close to zero, so the large |z| values come from small differences. r08's centre REGR peak is 51.68 %/h, against a batch median of 53.02 %/h (about 2.5% lower). Its peak position (421 µm), growth-zone length (684 µm) and flank difference match the batch, so r08 is a slower-growing root, not a fault. It took 5 steps but ended on default settings (stride 1, no registration, no masking). The 11 µm shifts in r02/r04 (flank-difference position) and r03/r07 (growth-zone length) are small next to the values themselves.
Note: three groups of runs have identical check values and summaries: r01/r05/r06, r02/r04 and r03/r07. Confirm that these are separate roots or time windows and not duplicated records. If they are duplicates, the batch median and MAD would be biased.
Common to flagged runs: none. No runs were flagged.
